definition: Low-grade, improvised combat geneware or cybernetic augmentations installed without professional medical supervision, typically in Shelf-level chop shops. Functional but unstable, prone to rejection flares and uncontrolled activation. Named for the crude, visible seam scarring left at joint sites.
usage: Tier 1-2 street fighters, Shelf gangs, black market surgeons
example: You can tell Ferro's crew by the knuckle ware — arms look like someone stitched a machine inside a man and ran out of thread halfway through.
